description: This file defines the LeaveOverlapParams class, which is a Data Transfer Object (DTO) used within the Leave module of the OrangeHRM human resource management system. The class extends LeaveParameterObject and provides methods related to leave overlap parameters, including overriding some inherited methods to throw exceptions when certain operations are not allowed.

classes.name: LeaveOverlapParams
classes.description: A Data Transfer Object representing parameters for checking leave overlaps, extending LeaveParameterObject, with specific method implementations.

methods.name: getLeaveType
methods.description: Returns the leave type, but in this class it throws an exception indicating the operation is not allowed.

methods.name: setLeaveType
methods.description: Sets the leave type, but in this class it is an empty implementation.

methods.name: getComment
methods.description: Returns a comment, but in this class it throws an exception indicating the operation is not allowed.

methods.name: setComment
methods.description: Sets a comment, but in this class it has an empty implementation.

methods.name: getLogicException
methods.description: Returns a LogicException indicating that the operation is not permitted.
